title: Ukraine EU Accession: Council Vote on Cluster 1 Opening Set for May 26 — Final Preparations Underway
detail: With two days remaining before the scheduled May 26 Council vote on formally opening Cluster 1 ('Fundamentals') of Ukraine's EU accession negotiations, EU institutions and member state permanent representatives were completing final preparations on May 24. Ukraine's Deputy PM Taras Kachka confirmed no outstanding legal or procedural obstacles remain. All 27 EU member states are expected to vote in favour following Hungary's pro-EU pivot under Prime Minister Péter Magyar, which removed the last political veto. Opening Cluster 1 — covering the rule of law, fundamental rights, democratic governance, and the functioning of public institutions — is a milestone in the fastest accession process in EU history, given Ukraine's June 2024 formal launch of negotiations. Deputy PM Kachka also stated Ukraine remains on track to open all six clusters before the Cyprus Presidency concludes on June 30, which would put the full negotiating framework in place within the year. EU Enlargement Commissioner Kos called the moment 'historic for European integration.'

sources.name: European Pravda — Ukraine sees no obstacles to May 26 cluster opening

title: EU-US Trade Deal: EP Ratification Vote Scheduled for Mid-June Ahead of Trump's July 4 Deadline
detail: The European Parliament's International Trade Committee confirmed on May 24 that the full plenary ratification vote on the EU-US trade implementation package — agreed provisionally on May 20 — is scheduled for mid-June 2026, leaving a narrow but achievable margin ahead of President Trump's July 4 deadline. The deal scraps EU tariffs on US industrial goods and caps US tariffs on most EU exports at 15%, with a steel and aluminium safeguard clause. The European Parliament's Trade Committee was briefed on the deal's text and key safeguards by Commissioner for Trade Maroš Šefčovič. MEPs from France and the Greens reiterated concerns about insufficient protection for European industry and the precedent set by accepting a deal under US deadline pressure. The EP's Legal Affairs committee is in parallel reviewing the provisional application mechanism, which would allow some elements to take effect before formal ratification. A failure to ratify by July 4 would risk triggering US 25% tariffs on EU automobile exports.

sources.name: Euronews — EU approves trade deal with the US despite uncertainty in transatlantic relations
CNBC — EU-US trade deal clears key hurdle ahead of Trump deadline
